summary: Realty Income Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to 150 million shares of common stock through multiple agents and forward sellers. The filing describes a sales agreement allowing sales at prevailing market prices on the NYSE or in negotiated transactions. No fixed price, premium, or specific terms are provided; the structure includes potential forward sale agreements and contingent forward transactions. This is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or strategic events to analyze; the filing simply enables ongoing equity issuance at market.
